scope: NTS wasm32 PHP 8.5.12, exactly one request per fresh WASI instance

upstream.source_hash_basis: UTF-8 bytes cached from primary GitHub files at the full commit; Git blob SHA-1 recomputed from those bytes; builder must independently verify its fetched source

context_api_reference.role: public API reference, not a source-build attestation of the pinned sysroot archive

build_design.changed_feature: explicit WASIX backend replaces only the opt-in fiber backend; native boost/ucontext and default WASI failure branches remain

runtime_design.engine: wasmer 7.2.0, backend-specific Cranelift and LLVM records required
runtime_design.required_host_teardown_order: complete or fail run_wasm; drop context executor and runtime references before releasing instance memory; collect pipe EOF and owned-child reap

backend_design.context_handle: pointer to private libc-allocation descriptor, never a u64-to-void* cast
backend_design.transfer: existing shallow transfer ownership; receive mailbox before sender cleanup; no extra zval addref
backend_design.bootstrap: NTS single-active-context bootstrap word; assembly installs aligned target SP before the first C prologue; C dispatcher reads EG(current_fiber_context)
backend_design.switch: Wasm-local old SP -> raw wasix_32v1.context_switch(i64)->i32 -> restore old SP -> C errno processing; no target SP prechange
backend_design.stack_allocator: existing Zend page rounding, minimum, mmap usable stack and guard reservation, with WASIX-only size-wrap rejection and libc-allocated metadata
backend_design.stack_size: existing fiber.stack_size; wasm32 default 1048576 bytes; oracle comparison explicitly passes 2097152 bytes
backend_design.logical_cleanup: existing VM state, observer, zval, Throwable/bailout and suspended-GC/finally control flow retained in source
backend_design.quarantine: all descriptor and stack headers outside request ZendMM; successful, retired and failed-init allocations retained; no guest free, munmap or reuse
backend_design.request_end: cancel remaining non-main native contexts, clear owner/mailbox links, retain guest allocations beyond request and module shutdown
backend_design.persistent_guard: second zend_fiber_init in the same guest terminates with fixed request failure
backend_design.unexpected_backend_errno: fixed stderr diagnostic and _Exit(125); never a successful PHP transfer
backend_design.host_trap: not intercepted or translated to a PHP Throwable; host must preserve failed result
backend_design.create_failure: throws an initialization exception; no silent fallback; allocated guest stack stays quarantined

bootstrap_export.name: rp_zend_wasix_bootstrap_sp
bootstrap_export.meaning: immutable i32 address export of an ordinary aligned linear-memory uintptr_t word, not the SP global

reject: switch linear-memory stores or extra calls
entry C call before SP installation
entry load from an unbound bootstrap address

fixed_fixture.owner: native oracle agent; referenced without modification

first_comparison_plan.invocation: fixed PHP code only, -n -d fiber.stack_size=2097152; no arbitrary guest paths/code
cases: multi_lifetime: four simultaneously suspended Fibers, one completes while others retain live recursion locals
nested: nested start/resume and current Fiber identity
values: suspend/resume value ownership and return values
throw_catch_finally: injected and unhandled exceptions, catch/finally order
suspended_gc: self-referencing suspended Fiber, GC, WeakReference and finally
first_comparison_plan.compare: strict native oracle semantics, warnings and no unexpected output; record observed runtime fields without replacing failed observations

cases: valid explicit stack size applies to newly started Fibers
too-small stack fails using the existing minimum-size path
negative INI setting is rejected; capture warning and unchanged value
default size is architecture-specific and must be recorded, not normalized

separate_oom_request.design: inside a Fiber, memory_limit=16M then fixed str_repeat of 64MiB; compare native/patched fatal/bailout outcome and require absence of a post-allocation success marker
separate_oom_request.scope: PHP heap OOM/bailout only; no deterministic physical C-stack exhaustion claim; own finite child required

first_comparison_plan.recovery: after every intentional failed child, run the fixed normal contract in a separate fresh WASI request

open_gates: independently verify upstream source/blob hashes and pinned toolchain before applying
compile and inspect the actual postopt PHP Wasm; the existing two-slot inspector is insufficient for this dynamic bootstrap
run strict native/patched six-case oracle on both backends
verify PHP exception, bailout and GC behavior in the presence of canceled native continuations
prove canceled contexts do not re-enter guest code referencing logically freed PHP objects
measure quarantine growth and resulting OOM differences under many sequential Fibers
do not free quarantined storage at PHP request shutdown; no public guest join/cancellation fence was identified
